correctness.rationale: For G=K_s vee (disjoint union K_{r_i}) with s,m>=2 and positive r_i, the zero-sum power-distance quadratic form equals alpha(a)T²-∑ beta_i(a)t_i² minus nonnegative within-block contrast squares, where a=2^p, alpha=a-1-1/s and beta_i=a-1+1/r_i. Weighted Cauchy–Schwarz makes CND equivalent to alpha∑(1/beta_i)<=1. Strictly increasing secular F crosses 1 once at a*>1+1/s, giving sharp p*=log2 a*, one critical null direction and endpoint Hilbert rank N-2. h_a(r)=r/(r(a-1)+1) has strictly negative second derivative for a>1, proving balancing strictly decreases the exponent; equal r gives a*=1+(m/s+1/r)/(m-1) and the five integer p=1 boundaries. Independently built three clique-core graphs (heterogeneous examples included), computed full shortest-path matrices and critical zero-sum spectral nullity and signs. These checks supplement the exact all-size identity.
